chart.title: Animal protein consumption
chart.subtitle: This is measured as the average daily supply per person.
chart.note: FAOSTAT applies a methodological change from the year 2010 onwards.
chart.citation: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025)

Fish and seafood | 00002960 || Food avai.titleShort: Daily per capita supply of proteins from fish and seafood
Fish and seafood | 00002960 || Food avai.titleLong: Daily per capita supply of proteins from fish and seafood
Fish and seafood | 00002960 || Food avai.descriptionShort: Quantity that is available for consumption at the end of the supply chain. It does not account for consumer waste, so the quantity that is actually consumed may be lower.
Fish and seafood | 00002960 || Food avai.descriptionProcessing:
* Per-capita values were obtained by dividing total figures by Our World in Data's population.
* For regions defined by FAOSTAT, per-capita values were calculated using FAOSTAT's original population data, if available.
* This data was originally given per-capita by FAOSTAT. We converted this data into total figures by multiplying by FAOSTAT's population.

The latest FAOSTAT release (published on 2025-10-28) is missing data for Benin, Burundi, Central African Republic, Chad, Dominica, Japan, Mali, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, and Togo, due to an ongoing review. To avoid data gaps, we sourced data for those countries from a previous FAOSTAT release.
Fish and seafood | 00002960 || Food avai.unit: grams of protein per day per capita
Fish and seafood | 00002960 || Food avai.citationShort: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025) – processed by Our World in Data
Fish and seafood | 00002960 || Food avai.citationLong: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025) – processed by Our World in Data. “Daily per capita supply of proteins from fish and seafood” [dataset]. Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, “Food Balances: Food Balances (-2013, old methodology and population)”; Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, “Food Balances: Food Balances (2010-)” [original data].
